item.title: Shamrock’s Lasalle: Different Ways To Invest in Sports
item.description: Mike LaSalle, co-president and partner at Shamrock Capital, says the firm is assessing how upcoming sports contracts and shifting cash flows could create investment opportunities. Jason Sklar, partner at Shamrock Capital, talks about the financial shortages emerging in the sports industry and the role Shamrock Capital plays. They speak with Romaine Bostick on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Alzheimer's Will Be a "Treatable Condition," Says David Cameron
item.description: David Cameron says that we have reached a "tipping point" where the combination of new Alzheimer's treatments and new biotech and pharmaceutical companies could result in someone alive today having their Alzheimer's condition 'reversed.' He speaks at a Bloomberg.com subscriber event in London. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AirAsia, Malaysia Airports in $122 Million Debt Repayment Talks
item.description: Malaysia Airports Holdings Bhd. is in talks with AirAsia Group Bhd. about a repayment plan for 500 million ringgit ($122 million) owed by the low-cost airline, according to the airport operator.

item.title: Colombia’s De La Espriella Vows Spending Cuts in Investor Pitch
item.description: Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella pledged spending cuts and fiscal discipline as he sought to reassure investors amid one of the country’s most severe fiscal crises in decades.

item.title: Betterment CEO Sarah Levy on Plus Debut, New IRA Options
item.description: Betterment CEO Sarah Levy discusses the company's newly announced Betterment Plus program, which brings together human guidance, individual stock trading, lending and partner products, and IRA custody. She speaks with Romaine Bostick and Vonnie Quinn on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)
